EXCELLENCE Montessori Preparatory and Modern High School is committed to providing a supportive learning environment where children can develop academically, socially and morally.

Our Academic Levels

Education from the early years through junior secondary school.

Preparatory

Nursery and primary education designed to build strong foundations in literacy, numeracy, creativity and good character.

Learning is supported by discipline, teamwork, sports, practical activities and opportunities for students to grow in confidence.
